evidence.title: Vehla – Mac command center: launcher, clipboard, windows & AI

name: Vehla
summary: Native macOS command center app: launcher palette, clipboard history, window management, dictation, file shelf and on-device AI actions.
description: A native macOS 15+ command center for Apple Silicon that replaces a stack of single-purpose utilities: launcher palette, clipboard intelligence, window management, dictation, OCR, file shelf, menu-bar cleanup and notes/canvas/Kanban workspaces. Text AI actions can run on-device through an MLX runtime, with cloud models as bring-your-own-key (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, OpenRouter), plus Ollama and LM Studio. Free forever tier; Pro is a one-time $29.99 for two Macs.
contains: native macOS 15+ app for Apple Silicon; free forever tier, Pro $29.99 once for two Macs
launcher palette, clipboard history, window management, dictation, OCR, file shelf, menu-bar cleanup
on-device AI via MLX; Ollama, LM Studio or cloud keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, OpenRouter)
workspaces: notes, canvas, Kanban, draw.io; Recall local retrieval index
SnapWheel pointer gestures, Island system surface, Dock Widgets, QuickGlass, Flow, Magic Rewrite
extensions: native Swift extensions, MCP servers, browser integration, Finder actions
version 8.5, build 406; 7-day Pro trial without card; docs and SDK included
made by Kaila Consulting Inc., Ottawa, Canada
